provenance.source_title: The Economics of Owning a Gas Station

examples.psychological_goal: 用第二人称邀约锁定对日常生意有幻想的观众
examples.expression_mechanism: 日常资产邀约（So you want to own X）
examples.example_text: Okay, so you want to own a gas station.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'你想拥有X'开场，X选观众每天接触却从没算过账的设施
examples.negative_instruction: X必须日常到观众有画面感，不要用陌生资产

examples.psychological_goal: 把观众的心算暴富内心戏原样演出来
examples.expression_mechanism: 内心独白重演（printing money / How hard can it be）
examples.example_text: this place must be printing money, you think. I want a piece of that. How hard can it be?
examples.usage_instruction: 学习替观众说出他们的天真计算，让后面的拆穿像自我发现
examples.negative_instruction: 独白必须是观众真实会想的话，不可替观众编造可笑想法

examples.psychological_goal: 指出观众思考的终点并把它变成正片起点
examples.expression_mechanism: 停止思考点标记（where most people stop thinking → where this gets interesting）
examples.example_text: here is exactly where this gets interesting.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'大多数人到这里就不想了，而这恰恰是有趣的地方'制造认知台阶
examples.negative_instruction: 标记后必须立刻兑现'有趣之处'，不可空转

examples.psychological_goal: 一句话反转主角与配角，悬挂主悬念
examples.expression_mechanism: 主配角反转（the X is almost an afterthought）
examples.example_text: The fuel you are buying is almost an afterthought to the people who own the place.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'你以为的主角其实是附属品'作为全片引擎
examples.negative_instruction: 反转必须在后文用数据证明，否则只是标题党

examples.psychological_goal: 把分类学清单升级为'答案取决于类型'的判断框架
examples.expression_mechanism: 类型决定论（which one determines everything）
examples.example_text: which one you are standing in determines everything about how much money the owner makes.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习在罗列分类后补一句'选哪种决定结局'，让清单不再是流水账
examples.negative_instruction: 分类必须穷尽且互斥，否则框架不成立

examples.psychological_goal: 用'你以为X。不是。是Y。'开启资产解剖
examples.expression_mechanism: 否定+真实清单开场（You are not. You are buying...）
examples.example_text: You think you are buying pumps and a cash register. You are not. You are buying the land underneath the canopy.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习先给观众的简化想象一刀否定，再开始层叠列举
examples.negative_instruction: 否定后列举的每一项都要具体（土地/罐/许可证），不可泛泛

examples.psychological_goal: 用'别人赚得比业主多'的对比实锤+自我背书收束价格解剖
examples.expression_mechanism: 第三方超越对比 + '不是夸张，是数学'背书
examples.example_text: earns more per gallon in swipe fees than the station owner earns in actual profit. That is not an exaggeration. It is the math.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习在给出惊人对比后，用一句'这不是夸张，这是数学'自我锚定
examples.negative_instruction: 背书句只能紧跟可复算的演算，不可用于观点

examples.psychological_goal: 用收入占比与利润占比的倒挂揭示真实利润引擎
examples.expression_mechanism: 收入/利润占比对照（35% revenue vs 61.2% profit）
examples.example_text: made up 35% of revenue but generated 61.2% of total gross profit.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用同一主体的两个占比数字做倒挂对比
examples.negative_instruction: 两个占比必须来自同一数据源同一口径

examples.psychological_goal: 用一杯咖啡vs一次加油的净利对比完成核心反转
examples.expression_mechanism: 微vs巨净利对比（a single cup vs 12 gallons）
examples.example_text: A single cup of coffee generates more bottom-line profit than pumping 12-gallons of gasoline.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习把两个演算结果压成一句'最小的X打败最大的Y'
examples.negative_instruction: 对比双方必须先各自完整演算过，结论才有说服力

examples.psychological_goal: 用主语对调给行业本质定性
examples.expression_mechanism: 主配角对调金句（X is the business. Y is the advertisement.）
examples.example_text: These companies understood early that the food is the business. The fuel is the advertisement.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'X才是生意，Y只是广告'的对偶句收束案例群
examples.negative_instruction: 案例群必须先陈列（多家连锁），金句才有根基

examples.psychological_goal: 揭示新业务的真实价值不在其收入而在停留时间
examples.expression_mechanism: 真实价值重指（not the X revenue, the dwell time）
examples.example_text: it is the dwell time. A driver charging for 30 minutes buys coffee, eats a sandwich, and browses the store.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习问'这项业务真正卖的是什么'，并给出行为链条证据
examples.negative_instruction: 重指后必须有具体行为画面（买咖啡/吃三明治/逛店）

examples.psychological_goal: 揭示收购中最隐蔽的风险随产权转移
examples.expression_mechanism: 风险随产权转移揭示（buying X means buying the liability）
examples.example_text: When you buy a gas station, you are potentially buying the environmental liability that came with it.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'买X就是买下它的Y'提醒观众隐性负债
examples.negative_instruction: 必须随后给出缓解措施（购前评估）与残余风险，避免纯恐吓

examples.psychological_goal: 用拟人化宣判让地下负债的持久性可感
examples.expression_mechanism: 拟人化持久宣判（It sits in the ground until...）
examples.example_text: The liability does not disappear. It sits in the ground until someone pays to remove it.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'它不会消失，它坐在那里，直到有人付钱'的句式
examples.negative_instruction: 拟人化要克制，一句即止，不要发展成戏剧化

examples.psychological_goal: 用一句行为学冷幽默讲透'进出便利'的重要性
examples.expression_mechanism: 行为观察冷幽默（drivers do not make U-turns）
examples.example_text: Drivers do not make U-turns to fill up with gas.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用一句人人点头的行为观察代替长篇论证
examples.negative_instruction: 观察必须真实普遍；幽默服务于论证，不是段子

examples.psychological_goal: 用对仗宣判地段的第一变量地位
examples.expression_mechanism: Get X right / Get it wrong 对仗宣判
examples.example_text: Get location right and almost everything else is manageable. Get it wrong and no amount of operational excellence fixes the problem.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'做对了X一切可管理，做错了X无药可救'确定变量优先级
examples.negative_instruction: 宣判前必须有五要素清单等证据铺垫

examples.psychological_goal: 把净利换算成'每美元剩几美分'的体感尺度
examples.expression_mechanism: 单位换算落点（less than 3 cents of every dollar）
examples.example_text: That is on $461,000 in monthly gross revenue. Less than 3 cents of every dollar in sales flows to the bottom line.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习在整本账之后，把结果换算成最小货币单位制造震撼

examples.psychological_goal: 用'不是补充，是本体'完成反事实证明后的定性
examples.expression_mechanism: 否定弱表述+强定性（does not supplement, IS）
examples.example_text: The store does not supplement the business. The store is the business.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'X不是Y的补充，X就是Y'的递进句式
examples.negative_instruction: 强定性必须紧跟反事实证据（没有它月月亏）

examples.psychological_goal: 用行为倍数证明技术投资的回报
examples.expression_mechanism: 有无对照的行为倍数（3-4 times more than one who is not）
examples.example_text: A driver who is linked into a loyalty app visits that station three to four times more per month than one who is not.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'有X的顾客比没有的多Y倍'证明工具价值
examples.negative_instruction: 倍数需有来源；说明这是相关性观察而非承诺

examples.psychological_goal: 把观众的日常场景变成重放全片的入口
examples.expression_mechanism: 日常场景回收指令（next time you X, look past the Y）
examples.example_text: The next time you stop for fuel, look past the pump.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习在结尾给观众一个'下次身处某场景时看什么'的任务
examples.negative_instruction: 观察清单必须全部来自本片论点（咖啡区/洗车/充电桩）

examples.psychological_goal: 用'用A付账、用B引流'的对偶给全片封箱
examples.expression_mechanism: 功能对偶金句（uses A to pay the bills and B to fill the lot）
examples.example_text: It is a retail business that uses $4 cups of coffee to pay the bills and $3 gallons of gas to fill the parking lot.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'不是X，是用Y做Z的W'句式完成最终重定义
examples.negative_instruction: 对偶中的价格（$4/$3）必须与前文演算一致
